name: Nancy Bobofit
excerpt: Nancy Bobofit is a kleptomaniac student who frequently targets Percy Jackson.
notes: Nancy Bobofit is a freckly, redheaded girl at Yancy Academy known for her kleptomaniac tendencies and for bullying Percy Jackson. She often throws food at Grover and causes trouble during field trips. Nancy seems to have a special relationship with Mrs. Dodds, who favors her.
context_summary:
- Nancy is a student at Yancy Academy.
- She is freckly and redheaded.
- She is a kleptomaniac.
- Nancy bullies Percy Jackson.
- She throws food at Grover.
- She has a special relationship with Mrs. Dodds.
